slices.focus: A lot has shifted lately, and one piece of it finally caught up with me physical
slices.summary: After a spring asthma flare sends her to urgent care following two wet-basement inspections and a high-pollen day, Monica tightens her inhaler routine, creates a field-day checklist, and develops exposure thresholds including mask use and spacing of high-risk inspections to stay active in the field without pretending the triggers are imaginary.
open_loops: Build Sunday night prep reset for week's exposure risks
Draft work conversation about asthma adjustments
Keep spare masks and inhaler in work bag
decisions: After a spring asthma flare that sent her to urgent care, Monica now follows a stricter inhaler routine and is more care
